data.body: Epic 2f79-2b32-28c5-4eb3 completion resumed and finished. Existing code was already merged through Gerrit, including final change 1595 at 694cf894def36241724e7049e3308d782037ef6d with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; no new code push was needed. Renewed plans and completion certificates bottom-up for 742d, 953a, 1c1b, unexpectedly reopened 4752, and the epic. Corrected stale completed-state descriptions: workflow-local retry history is no longer described as current; strict push vocabulary distinguishes the original reasons from later push-multi-bundle-conflict; 1c1b records Python-owned CAS/commit-and-push, strict workflow adapters, best-effort library/MCP defaults, and brew/pip/MCP install continuity. Epic plan now explicitly covers CLI, Python library, MCP, brew, pip, MCP-server, legacy 0/1/2 and 3/4/75 vocabulary, portable provider environments, and ADR 0092 unique numbering plus docs/adr/README.md indexing. Final completion certificates for 742d, 953a, 1c1b, 4752, and epic are certified by principal b8a354e0-12c3-4cf2-bbf1-fcc9685d5126 at 694cf894def36241724e7049e3308d782037ef6d. All 20 descendants are closed. Prior code-leaf TDD evidence remains the merged RED-first/held-out suites: real-entrypoint CLI/library/MCP parity, legacy exit/default compatibility, pause/mixed-version behavior, provider portability, and real-git success/contention/rejected-push oracles. Residual-gap disposition: fixed in scope for interface/install-path/legacy/ADR coverage; accepted for unavoidable provider shell snippets because they are declarative/test artifacts and application behavior is Python-owned; no deferred blocking finding or weaker validation remains.
